findings.evidence: And it was not a kind thought. It had no kindness in it at all.
findings.diagnosis: The second sentence restates the first (named-then-paraphrased applied to un-kindness); the debt/bribe reframe after is load-bearing, so the doubling is redundant and edges toward insisting.

findings.evidence: the way nothing came at this hour
findings.diagnosis: Mild aphoristic 'the way...' construction; recast as a flat clause ('as nothing came at this hour').

findings.evidence: A man who ran was one thing and a man who stood was another, and she did not know yet which he was.
findings.diagnosis: A general maxim, anchored to her uncertainty so mostly earned; borderline.

findings.evidence: she was glad of the not being thanked
findings.diagnosis: 'glad' states the feeling; the inversion mostly carries it but the tell remains.
